name: †autre histire†~Vt
source:
About five months have passed since then.
February 14th... an important day for couples.
Valentine's Day.

As soon as the school bell rang, I ran out the classroom in a hurry...
...to go meet up with my beloved boyfriend.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091003214428fw_/http://park23.wakwak.com/~namikazenouta/minigame_v.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
从那以后，大约过去了五个月。

2月14日…对情侣们来说很重要的一天。

情人节。

放学铃声刚响，我就急忙跑出教室…

…去见我心爱的男朋友。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091003214428fw_/http://park23.wakwak.com/~namikazenouta/minigame_v.htm]官方网站[/url]]
